pages.title: Handle with Care
pages.text: Turn a stored stack into a transportable shipment.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Supply the native packaging setup and request available contents. The finished package must contain an item; rare decorative package skins are not required.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Attach a Packager to an inventory and power it; send a package into a receiving Packager. Move inventory contents as a package; a receiver refuses one it cannot fully unpack.
